app.name: Weekbeat

hobbies.title: What do you like to do, {{name}}?
hobbies.hint: Pick everything that fits, including things you would like to try. Weekbeat plans from these and adds what complements them.

length.title: How long is a session usually?
length.hint: In minutes. Leave it empty if it varies a lot.

auto.title: Should Weekbeat propose your week automatically?
auto.hint: On Sunday, or as soon as a new week has no plan yet. You confirm every proposal yourself and can change this any time in the settings.
auto.no: No, I will start planning myself

membership.hint: For example Wellpass, Urban Sports Club, Wellhub or your own gym. You add its places afterwards under “Places”.

coach.hint: Then Weekbeat plans your Coach days into the week and tells you what to set in the Coach. Nothing is sent to Freeletics.

health.title: Health and pause
health.intro: Before you start, a short health check for {{name}}. Only the result is saved, not your answers.
health.answerAll: Please answer every question with yes or no.
health.privacy: These questions are a short selection in our own words, not a full questionnaire. The official PAR-Q+ goes further:
health.disclaimer: Weekbeat is for fitness and wellness. It is not a medical device and does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
health.flaggedTitle: Please check with a doctor first
health.flagged: At least one answer was yes. Please talk to a doctor before you train, {{name}}. This is not a diagnosis: these questions only show when talking to a doctor before you start is recommended.
health.flaggedNext: Until then your plan rests, and goals and streak are frozen. When your doctor says you may train, confirm it under Settings → Health and pause.
health.held: Health check of {{date}}: at least one yes. The plan rests.
health.doctorOk: My doctor says I may train
health.pausedUntil: Paused up to and including {{date}}: goals and streak rest.
health.pauseHint: For example when ill, injured or on holiday. You can change the end at any time.
health.pauseEnded: Pause ended. From today everything counts again.

banner.held: Your plan rests until you confirm that your doctor allows training.
banner.paused: Pause up to and including {{date}}: goals and streak rest.

rest.hint: Planned recovery: Weekbeat plans nothing on this day.

manualLog.title: Log an activity ({{name}})
manualLog.hint: Saved on this device only. Unplanned counts like planned.

review.title: Looking back at this week
review.hint: Just a look back. Tomorrow simply continues with the next week.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Weekbeat has no server and no account. What you enter stays on this device.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: The controller for this website under the GDPR is:

device.title: What is stored on your device
device.text: Household, people, times, places, memberships, plans, logged activities and the result of the health self-check (not your answers) are kept in this browser's storage (IndexedDB). Language and the selected person are kept in local storage. So that the app works offline, the browser stores its files on the device. This storage is needed for the app to work for you, so it does not ask for separate consent.

none.title: No cookies, no tracking
none.text: The app sets no cookies, has no analytics and no ads, and loads nothing from other servers. Links to other sites open only when you tap them.

host.title: Hosting
host.text: The app is served by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). When you open it, GitHub says it logs and stores your IP address for security purposes. Your planning data never reaches GitHub.
host.docs: GitHub: data collection on GitHub Pages

control.title: You are in control
control.text: Under Settings → Your data you can export everything as a file. The file contains health information; keep it safe. To delete everything, clear this site's data in your browser settings or remove the installed app.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. Your planning data is only on your device; we can neither see nor delete it. For GitHub's logs, contact GitHub (see the GitHub Privacy Statement). Questions go to the e-mail address above.

connectors.title: Connections to other services
connectors.text: Planned connections (for example to calendars or training services) stay off until you switch them on and agree. This page will then say which data goes where.

imprint.title: Legal notice

about.title: About Weekbeat
about.text: Weekbeat is a private, non-commercial open-source project. There are no ads, no payments and no accounts. Weekbeat is not affiliated with any provider it works with. Names such as Wellpass, Freeletics or Garmin only describe what the app works with; the trademarks belong to their owners.

purpose.title: Intended purpose
purpose.text: Weekbeat plans exercise and recovery for your week, for fitness and wellbeing. It is not intended to detect, prevent, monitor, treat or alleviate diseases or injuries, and it is not a medical device. The health self-check before the start makes no diagnosis: for every yes it recommends talking to a doctor before you train and rests the plan until then.

imprint.basis: Information under § 18(1) of the German Interstate Media Treaty (Medienstaatsvertrag, MStV).
